Bullets 2, 3 and 4 collapse into one rung. Piece of evidence DOES resolve as key item 3231, and I deliberately did NOT use it as evidence. The page calls it a Temporary Key Item, and temporary key items are not in the key-item bitfield the runtime reads; evidence that can never read true would pin the ladder on this rung forever, which is a wrong marker rather than a missing one. Sublime lucky egg (KI 3232) is a normal key item, is granted on defeating the NM, and is not the Reward (Oden x12), so it is the mission's one evidence point and sits on the fight.
